name: caveman-browse
title_zh: 用快照-行动-验证循环驯服任何网页
tagline_zh: 网页再乱也不怕：先快照再动手，大页面先查后点，卡住就恢复精确字节。浏览器操作从此有章法。
tagline_en: Tame any webpage with snapshot-act-verify. Query first on big pages, recover exact bytes when stuck. Browsing.
desc_en: Drive web pages through the caveman-browse MCP tools (browser_snapshot, browser_act, browser_eval, browser_recover). Use whenever interacting with a web page, dashboard, or form through caveman-browse — it teaches the snapshot→act→verify loop, query-first discipline on large pages, and when to recover exact bytes.
why_zh: 把浏览器操作变成可验证的循环，而非盲点乱试。查询优先于点击，恢复机制保证每次操作都有据可依。
why_en: Turns browsing into a verifiable loop, not blind clicking. Query-before-act discipline plus byte-exact recovery keeps every step.
limit_zh: 只适配 caveman-browse MCP 工具链，需自行配置 MCP 服务器；不处理验证码、登录墙或反爬。
limit_en: Requires caveman-browse MCP server setup. No captcha/login-wall/anti-bot handling. Outputs action sequences only, not data reports.
